map.木本（月季/绣球）可略多加糖促开放；敏感花（非洲菊/鸢尾）糖量宜低；水面以下叶要: Woody stems (rose, hydrangea) can take slightly more sugar to open faster; sensitive flowers (gerbera, iris) want less sugar; remove all leaves below the waterline, recut 1-2 cm daily and keep out of direct sun with airflow. These matter more for vase life than the recipe alone.

map.鲜花保鲜液配比（商用/糖水应急） 使用指南: Cut-Flower Preservative Ratio (Commercial / Sugar-Water Emergency) User Guide
map.按花瓶水量和商品标签计算保鲜剂克数，避免把 10g 标准包与 5g 透明包套用同: Calculate preservative grams from vase water and the product label, so a 10g standard packet and a 5g clear packet are never treated as the same “one packet”. Without a commercial preservative, only sugar water can be used briefly as an emergency; it contains no disinfectant.
map.按水量 × 标签推荐浓度计算可利鲜、花之寿等商用保鲜剂用量与折算包数。: Calculate Chrysal, Floral Life and similar commercial preservatives from water volume × label concentration, including the equivalent packet count.
map.分别区分 10g/包、5g/包等规格，给出所需克数与约几包。: Distinguish 10g and 5g packet sizes and show the required grams and approximate packets.
map.提供糖水应急配比（糖 2g/500ml），并明确不含杀菌剂、只适合短时应急。: Provide an emergency sugar-water ratio (2g sugar per 500ml) and state clearly that it has no disinfectant and is for short-term use only.
map.花店、婚礼与活动用花按瓶数批量配液，需要统一浓度。: Florists, weddings and events mixing solution for many vases need a consistent concentration.
map.家用花瓶按毫升数换算商品保鲜剂，避免凭感觉倒粉。: Households can convert a commercial preservative from the vase volume instead of guessing how much powder to add.
map.临时缺商用保鲜剂时，用糖水短时维持，但需尽快换正规保鲜剂。: If a commercial preservative is temporarily unavailable, sugar water can maintain flowers briefly, but replace it with a proper preservative as soon as possible.
map.量出花瓶实际水量（ml），填入“花瓶水量”。: Measure the actual vase water (ml) and enter it in “Vase water”.
map.选择商品类型，核对包装标注的克数与兑水量；不同规格分开计算。: Choose the product type and check the packet weight and dilution on the label; calculate different package sizes separately.
map.按结果称量并搅匀，每 2–3 天换液、斜剪花茎 1–2 cm。: Weigh the calculated amount, stir well, change the solution every 2–3 days and re-cut stems 1–2cm diagonally.
map.算例：500ml 水配可利鲜标准（10g/500ml）=10g，正好 1 包；配: Example: 500ml water with standard Chrysal (10g/500ml) needs 10g = 1 packet; clear Chrysal or Floral Life (5g/500ml) needs 5g = 1 packet. The gram amounts differ, so “one packet” cannot be used interchangeably. Sugar-water emergency: 2g sugar per 500ml.
map.⚠ 严禁把含氯漂白剂与白醋、柠檬酸等酸性物质混合，可能释放有毒氯气；本工具不再提: ⚠ Never mix chlorine bleach with white vinegar, citric acid or other acids — it can release toxic chlorine gas. This tool no longer provides such mixed recipes.
map.糖水不含杀菌剂，易滋生细菌，只适合短时应急，效果远弱于商用保鲜剂。: Sugar water contains no disinfectant, spoils easily and is far weaker than commercial preservatives; short-term emergency only.
map.商品浓度以包装标签为准；品牌、规格、用途不同，不能直接套用其他产品的克数。: Follow the package label; brands, sizes and uses differ, so do not apply another product’s gram amount directly.
map.糖水应急配方靠谱吗？: Is the sugar-water emergency recipe reliable?
map.只能短时提供糖分，不含杀菌剂，易滋生细菌，效果远弱于商用保鲜剂，只适合应急。切勿: It only supplies sugar briefly, contains no disinfectant, spoils easily and is far weaker than commercial preservatives; emergency use only. Never add acid or chlorine bleach.
map.为什么 500ml 水有时是 10g、有时是 5g？: Why does 500ml water sometimes need 10g and sometimes 5g?
map.因为包装规格不同：标准可利鲜常见 10g/包兑 500ml，透明款与花之寿常见: Because package sizes differ: standard Chrysal is commonly 10g per 500ml, while clear Chrysal and Floral Life are commonly 5g per 500ml. Read the label weight first, then scale by water volume.
map.商品保鲜剂按标签使用；木本（月季/绣球）可略多补水，敏感花（非洲菊/鸢尾）避免浓: Use commercial preservatives according to the label; woody stems (roses/hydrangeas) may need more water, while sensitive flowers (gerberas/iris) should avoid strong sugar. Remove submerged leaves, re-cut stems daily and keep away from sun and heat.
map.包装规格与预设不同，可选“自定义（按包装标签）”，分别填写标签克数、对应水量和每: If the package differs from the presets, choose “Custom (label-based)” and enter the label dose, dilution water and net weight per packet; the tool calculates from those values instead of preset grams.
